description: This file defines a class for rendering a star-shaped marker in a graph, extending a base marker class, and includes the method to draw the star on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Star
classes.description: A class representing a star-shaped marker for graph plotting, extending the base marker class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a star shape on the canvas at specified (x, y) position.
